# PCMag

> PCMag is a leading technology publication providing expert product reviews, buying guides, and tech news across computing, consumer electronics, and digital services.

PCMag offers comprehensive testing and recommendations for laptops, desktops, phones, tablets, and accessories, with an AI-powered product finder and deals aggregation. The site covers hardware reviews, software recommendations, cybersecurity solutions, and emerging technology trends.

## Key Topics

- Product Reviews
- Buying Guides
- Editors' Choice
- Best of 2026
- Laptops
- Desktops
- Gaming Hardware
- Smartphones
- Tablets
- Cybersecurity
- VPN Services
- Antivirus Software
- Networking
- Consumer Electronics
- Tech Brands

## Computing Devices

- [The Best Laptops We've Tested (March 2026)](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-laptops): Expert laptop reviews and buying guide for budget, productivity, gaming.
- [The Best PCs (Desktop Computers) We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-desktop-computers): Desktop PC reviews covering towers, all-in-ones, and mini PCs with advice.
- [The Best Gaming Laptops We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-gaming-laptops): Gaming laptop reviews with performance benchmarks and budget options.
- [The Best Graphics Cards We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-graphics-cards): GPU reviews for Nvidia GeForce, AMD Radeon, Intel Arc gaming cards.

## Mobile & Tablets

- [The Best Phones We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-phones): Phone reviews for iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel across carriers.
- [The Best Tablets We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-tablets): Tablet reviews and comparisons for Amazon, Apple iPad, and Android.

## Networking & Storage

- [The Best Wi-Fi Routers We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-wireless-routers): Wi-Fi router reviews and home networking guide with TP-Link recommendations.
- [The Best External Hard Drives We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-external-hard-drives): External hard drive reviews for backup and storage with WD products.

## Cybersecurity & Privacy

- [The Best VPNs We've Tested (March 2026)](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-vpn-services): VPN service reviews including Proton VPN for online privacy protection.
- [The Best Antivirus Software We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-antivirus-protection): Antivirus software reviews from Bitdefender, Norton for PC security.
- [The Best Password Managers We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-password-managers): Password manager reviews including NordPass, Proton Pass for security.

## Audio & Entertainment

- [The Best Headphones We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-headphones): Headphone and earbud reviews including Sony, Apple AirPods Pro.
- [The Best TVs We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-tvs): TV reviews covering OLED, QLED, LED with 4K and 8K options.

## Peripherals & Software

- [The Best All-in-One Printers We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-all-in-one-printers): All-in-one printer reviews from Brother, Canon for home and office.
- [The Best Printers We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-printers): Printer reviews comparing inkjet and laser from HP, Epson for home/work.
- [The Best Video Editing Software We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-video-editing-software): Video editing software reviews for content creators and professionals.
- [The Best Web Hosting Services We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-web-hosting-services): Web hosting reviews for shared, cloud, VPS, and managed hosting.

## Optional

- [PCMag Homepage](https://www.pcmag.com): PCMag homepage with tech reviews, news, deals, and AI product finder.
- [The Best Tech Brands for 2026, Ranked](https://www.pcmag.com/articles/the-best-tech-brands-for-2026): Definitive ranking of 25 best technology companies based on lab testing.
- [The Best Robot Vacuums We've Tested (March 2026)](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-robot-vacuums): Robot vacuum reviews including Ecovacs Deebot for home cleaning.
